title: CCID dwLength integer overflow before size_t cast
description:
In wp11_ccid.c ~line 373, the check 'frame_in_len < (CCID_HEADER_LEN + resp_dw_length)' adds a uint32_t from untrusted card data to a constant before the size_t cast. On 32-bit targets, if resp_dw_length = 0xFFFFFFF6 and CCID_HEADER_LEN=10, the sum wraps to 0 and the bounds check passes, allowing memcpy to read far past the receive buffer. A malicious or buggy token can trigger this.

Fix: check overflow before the addition:
  if (resp_dw_length > SIZE_MAX - CCID_HEADER_LEN || frame_in_len < CCID_HEADER_LEN + resp_dw_length)

Add inline comment explaining the overflow guard.
